top_signals.title: U.K. Sanctions Cryptomus for RU Money Laundering
top_signals.summary: The United Kingdom has issued economic sanctions against Cryptomus, a chameleonic cryptocurrency platform that experts say serves as a major conduit for payments related to ransomware, narcotics, darknet markets, fraud and cybercrime services that are helping Russia circumvent existing financial restrictions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Korea Financial Firms Hit By More Hacks as Asia Breaches Grow
top_signals.summary: South Korea’s financial industry was hit by a second wave of cyberattacks in about a month as a wave of breaches across Asia heightens concerns that artificial intelligence is making large-scale hacking easier.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Aussie-Kiwi Rates Split Drives Biggest Currency Move in 9 Years
top_signals.summary: New Zealand’s dollar slid the most in nine years against its Australian peer after the smaller nation’s central bank unexpectedly kept policy rates on hold, while cost pressures across the Tasman accelerated.
